assumptions.statement: The overall site and three key-area polygons are repository-maintained provisional placeholders fitted to announced order and approximate area; they are not official redlines and have not been anchored to named stations or roads.
assumptions.impact: All area, ratio, land-use, public-space, building, road and phasing results are conceptual and must be recomputed from versioned official polygons.

assumptions.statement: Repository Issue #1029 documents that PROV-KEY-003 is an order-and-area placeholder near Beijing North Railway Station rather than a station-anchored Dazhongsi boundary.
assumptions.impact: The Dazhongsi station integration and four-quadrant walking proposal is a non-georeferenced design brief response only; PROV-KEY-003 must not be treated as its location evidence.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: Development intensity, retain-renovate-demolish, road alignment, utilities and implementation remain methods or conceptual suggestions rather than approved conclusions.

assumptions.statement: Parcel ownership, existing-building attributes, heritage controls, traffic counts, public-service capacity and municipal safety baselines are unavailable in the cleared site package.
assumptions.impact: Project cards require professional survey and owner/authority confirmation before parcel-level or engineering decisions.

assumptions.statement: No site-specific biodiversity, catchment, stormwater-performance, community-food, compute-energy, waste-heat or water-use baseline is claimed by this submission.
assumptions.impact: The four ledgers define a survey and accountability protocol only. Habitat, rainwater, food and resource-budget interventions remain closed tests or display concepts until baselines, stewards, safety review and stop conditions are documented.

assumptions.statement: The author has not completed an organizer-authorized site visit or stakeholder interviews for this second proposal; user groups are inferred personas, not validated demand.
assumptions.impact: Phase 0 must verify space, access, nuisance, safety and objections before any pilot is located.

assumptions.statement: Phase 1 proposes no new permanent building and uses only lawfully approved existing or reversible space; this is a design gate, not a claim that suitable space is currently vacant or available.
assumptions.impact: All candidate carriers require ownership, permitted-use, fire, accessibility, utilities and operating-agreement checks.

assumptions.statement: The repository geometry is provisional and PROV-KEY-003 is not treated as evidence of the precise Dazhongsi station or four-quadrant walking location.
assumptions.impact: No precise station engineering, redline, parcel or walking-distance claim is made; official geometry triggers full recalculation.

assumptions.statement: No resident, worker, student, property owner, disability group, elderly-service organization or operator has endorsed the proposal.
assumptions.impact: An objection ledger and informed participation process are mandatory before continuation beyond a reversible test.
